reviews.body: yo @pcbeingused333 lmk if the safety changes i added seem fine, we can merge it then

comments.body: Thanks @natolambert, both changes look good to me. I checked against anthropic 1.14.0: `Messages.create` no longer has `temperature` in its signature, so `extra_body` is the right way to keep it, and the ratings path in `chat_completion` needed the same fix. The `<2` cap makes sense too. `tests/test_anthropic_judge.py` passes on 1352986 (3 passed). Good to merge from my side.
